string.description:
The value to display for this cell. This will be empty if the source is null, otherwise it will be a shortish
string representation. Generally this will be the natural string representation of the value, but may also be
a custom representation appropriate to the source.

To determine if the raw value was `null` check #source. To determine if there was a value at all, check #fillIn.

@see DataGrid.FormatSpec

source.description:
The raw cell value. This can be any value, including an {@link Obj} so generally the #string should be displayed
to the user.

fillIn.description:
True if this cell does not represent an actual data location, but is only synthesized to create a rectangular grid
out of a ragged data shape. In this case the #source will be null and #string will be empty. However this does not
indicate a null value, but instead a cell where no value is possible.

title: Contents of each cell in a {@link DataGrid}.
name: DataGrid.Cell
